items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I never knew about it, but I knew, first of all, that Preston and Billie were very close.

ctx.x: his friendship. He never did, never did.
Well, the circumstances -- what was the story, though, that he got Billie Holiday and Audrey fired?
I never knew about it, but I knew, first of all, that Preston and Billie were very close.
